messages.text:
"Create a 2D isometric survival game inspired by Project Zomboid, The Long Dark, and Terraria. The game should feature a highly realistic survival simulation in a post-apocalyptic open world where civilization has collapsed.

Focus on realistic survival mechanics, including hunger, thirst, body temperature, fatigue, sleep, diseases, injuries, nutrition, hygiene, and mental health. Every action should have consequences, and the player must carefully manage resources to stay alive.

Include a dynamic ecosystem, realistic weather, seasonal changes, day-and-night cycles, wildlife behavior, farming, hunting, fishing, crafting, resource gathering, and modular base building.

The world should be persistent and explorable, featuring abandoned cities, rural villages, forests, mountains, swamps, farms, and industrial areas. Buildings and resources should deteriorate or regenerate naturally over time.

Implement a detailed crafting system, realistic food spoilage, water purification, clothing insulation, tool durability, and a character progression system based on practical experience.

The game should have an immersive atmosphere, detailed 2D isometric environments, pixel-art-inspired graphics, intuitive mobile controls, and an inventory management system.

The difficulty should be balanced: challenging and realistic, but fair enough to allow players to learn from mistakes and recover.

The main objective is not to save the world, but to survive, adapt, explore, and build a sustainable life after the collapse.

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.
"
